## llama-3-8b-chat-doctor
This model is a fine-tuned version of [meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct) on an [ruslanmv/ai-medical-chatbot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ruslanmv/ai-medical-chatbot) dataset.

## Files
It contains the adopter, full model, and quantized GGUF file for using it locally.
